snippet.title: The Girl from Arkanya - PC Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
The Girl from Arkanya will be available on Steam and Itch.io on August 21st!

FREE DEMO available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1447820/The_Girl_from_Arkanya/

The Girl from Arkanya is a pixel art adventure RPG about an aspiring young treasure hunter and her capybara companion! Inspired by Four Swords adventures, players can control both the treasure hunter Marisa and her capybara companion, Kapi! Or you can bring a friend for local co-op!

Twitter/X: https://x.com/ArkanyaGame
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/arkanyagames.bsky.social
